response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans), account_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_avgs.account_id, account_avgs.avg_amount, account_avgs.avg_amount - overall_avg.avg_amount as excess FROM account_avgs CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE account_avgs.avg_amount > overall_avg.avg_amount ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
